notes.title: Our Kickstarter is Over! Thank You All So Much!
notes.notes:
Hey guys, 

First of all a HUGE THANK YOU to everyone for supporting the campaign! We're super excited that we were able to raise $252,404, which is more than we ever thought possible! We're so, so grateful to the community! 

From over 5,000 wonderful backers, we are now able to bring: 

🦄 [b]20 Rare and Exotic Animals[/b] to populate the zoo, each with unique behaviors and traits.

📖 [b]Animal Encyclopedia[/b]: An in-game guide detailing the animals, their habitat and preferences.

🐦 [b]Bird Aviary:[/b] A special habitat for unique bird species, adding new dimensions to customization of your park.

🛍️ [b]Tourist Zone & Shops:[/b] A dedicated area for visitors, featuring themed shops and attractions.

🌴 [b]Second Island Expansion:[/b] A brand-new area with additional NPCs, diverse flora, and unique fauna.

🎮 [b]Console Support:[/b] The game is set to be available on PS5, Xbox, and Switch, allowing players to enjoy it on their favorite platform.

👪[b]Kids and Family System:[/b] Watch your children grow up! Families can have up to two children! 

On Discord, you’ll get access to real-time updates, behind-the-scenes insights, and the chance to share ideas and be even more involved in Super Zoo Story's development. While we’ll keep sharing major updates on Kickstarter, Discord will allow for instant updates and a closer connection with our progress, no matter how big or small the news.

[url=https://discord.gg/QMB7RfUDqv][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42508046/882a75e2bee3a030ab3d84764ee966eb8ed4dc17.png[/img]
[/url]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42508046/10d2c7f66b6ecb6c21a8af7a0379612bce80ff71.png[/img]

Thank you for walking with us every step of the way. Your support has been everything, and we’re beyond excited to continue this journey together.

We can’t wait to bring Super Zoo Story to life with the best community a game could ever have. You’re truly the best!

Thank you all so, so much, from the bottom of our hearts! ♥️

notes.title: Super Zoo Story Launches Kickstarter on Oct 1st – New Trailer Out Now!
notes.notes:
Hey, future zoo keepers! 🦁🐧

We have some exciting news to share! After years of hard work and passion, we’re thrilled to announce that Super Zoo Story will be launching a Kickstarter campaign on [b]October 1st, 2024[/b]. This campaign will help us bring our dream of creating the ultimate wildlife sanctuary experience to life, and we can't wait to take you along on this journey!

To give you a sneak peek at what’s in store, we’ve just dropped a brand-new teaser trailer. It has fresh gameplay footage, including glimpses of the diverse habitats, the vibrant townsfolk, and, of course, the amazing array of animals you’ll care for in your sanctuary. Whether you're excited about building, exploring, or simply enjoying the pixel-art charm, this trailer has something for everyone.

[previewyoutube=SANtrDg0l5I;full][/previewyoutube]

Mark your calendars for October 1st, 2024, and stay tuned for more updates as we [url=https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/pixelgames4you/super-zoo-story]get closer to the launch[/url]. We’re incredibly grateful for your enthusiasm and support, and we can’t wait to embark on this adventure together!

[url=https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/pixelgames4you/super-zoo-story][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42508046/b2765d2f216c385873043ac0fba77957587771be.png[/img][/url]

[h3]Make sure to follow us on Discord![/h3]
